sloka: विष्टिकर्मान्तिकाः सर्वे मार्गशोधनरक्षकाः ।प्रस्थापिता मया पूर्वम् यात्रापि मम रोचते ॥२-८२-२०॥
transliteration: viṣṭikarmāntikāḥ sarve mārgaśodhanarakṣakāḥ ।prasthāpitā mayā pūrvam yātrāpi mama rocate ॥2-82-20॥

translations.english: I have already despatched the explorers and protectors of roads who work for wages and without wages as well. It also pleases me to undertake this journey.
